checks.name: Child can communicate before adult setup; setup can be dismissed without losing the message
Adult must confirm a PIN; no profiles, settings, audio or export are mounted before success
Returning to the child board locks parent access and preserves the message draft
Reload always returns to child access and never persists an authenticated parent session
Five failed attempts cause a persisted cooldown, including after reload; child board stays available
Parent-only PIN change requires current PIN and the new credential replaces the old one
Five minutes without input locks parent access while retaining the child message
Backgrounding locks the adult area and parent access works without network
A forgotten PIN is replaced with the written-down recovery code; the child’s message stays
Kwinjira links the device to the caregiver’s number and takes the account’s PIN; a forgotten PIN is then replaced with a texted code
A new device that signs in to the account gets the caregiver’s settings back
Alternate adult entries require a PIN, mobile gate fits, and damaged storage fails closed
A caregiver opens an account at the first setup with the code texted to their number and the PIN they choose
On another new device the number signs in with its PIN; wrong PINs lock it, and a texted code sets a new PIN

note: Isolated test context; test PINs are disposable. Background event is simulated; idle clock is advanced. This local gate does not authenticate an adult identity or protect against browser-storage access.
